ev.aw_letter_child.title: News from afar
ev.aw_letter_child.text: A merchant back from the long road brought word from {npc}: alive and well, sending greetings and remembering home. You reread those words until you knew them by heart.
ev.aw_letter_sibling.title: A letter from your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister}
ev.aw_letter_sibling.text: {npc} sent word from distant lands: life is up and down, but {g=npc_sex:he|she} doesn't complain and invites you to visit "if you're ever in these parts."
ev.aw_monastery_visit.title: At the cloister
ev.aw_monastery_visit.text: You went to the cloister to see {npc}. Strange clothes, strange words – and then the same smile as in childhood. Parting was easier than you expected.
ev.aw_return_child.title: {g=npc_sex:Your son|Your daughter} is back
ev.aw_return_child.text: At sunset, at the gate – {npc}. Older, sunburned, in foreign clothes, but it's {g=npc_sex:your son|your daughter}. "I'm back. Will you take me in?"
ev.aw_return_child.embrace.ok: You hugged {npc} right at the gate. That evening the table was crowded and loud, as it hadn't been in years.
ev.aw_return_child.cold.ok: You let {npc} in, but the old hurt stayed. You live under one roof and talk about the weather.
ev.aw_return_child.refuse: Don't let them past the door
ev.aw_return_child.refuse.ok: You shut the gate. {npc} stood there a while, then went back to that faraway life.
ev.aw_return_sibling.title: Your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} is back
ev.aw_return_sibling.text: {npc} came back from distant lands with no money and nowhere to live, and asks to stay with you until back on their feet.
ev.aw_return_sibling.take_in.ok: {npc} now lives nearby and tells stories of far countries in the evenings – even the neighbors come to listen.
ev.aw_return_sibling.help_little.ok: You gave a little money. {npc} thanked you and left again – to look for luck somewhere else.
ev.aw_ransom_child.title: The captive is found
ev.aw_ransom_child.text: Word came through a go-between: {npc} is alive and can be ransomed. The owner wants a lot of money and won't wait.
ev.aw_ransom_child.pay.ok: You paid everything they asked. A month later {npc} crossed the threshold of home – thin and quiet, but alive.
ev.aw_ransom_child.borrow.ok: You had to borrow at a heavy rate. But {npc} is home – the debts you'll manage somehow.
ev.aw_ransom_child.cannot: There's no way to raise it
ev.aw_ransom_child.cannot.ok: You couldn't raise the ransom. The go-between shrugged and left. You didn't sleep that night.
ev.aw_ransom_sibling.title: Ransom for your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister}
ev.aw_ransom_sibling.text: {npc} is alive and in bondage: the owner will let {g=npc_sex:him|her} go for a ransom.
ev.aw_ransom_sibling.pay.ok: {npc} is free and back home. A debt like that is never forgotten.
ev.aw_ransom_sibling.cannot.ok: The money wasn't there. You prayed the owner would turn out to be a kind man.
